resources.string: BrainWatch uses this service to count your scrolls and reels inside Instagram so it can show how tired your dopamine system has become. It reads only Instagram\'s screen layout to tell Reels from the Feed - nothing else. No data leaves your phone. You can disable it anytime.
Estimates only. Brains are notoriously hard to measure — this app does not give medical advice and no screen-reading data is ever sent off your device.

Your brain is a factory of feel-good chemicals. Every scroll and reel fires little dopamine hits. This tracker estimates how drained that factory is today, and shows it on the brain. Take a walk when it gets tired.

Time tracking needs “Usage access”. Scroll & reel counting needs the tracking service toggled on in Accessibility settings. The overlay needs “Display over other apps”. Everything stays 100% on-device.
All sensors active — a live watch appears on top of Instagram.
No sessions yet today. Scroll some Instagram and come back!
Buzzing — you are grinding through some dopamine
Fresh & focused — your reward system is recharged
Fuzzy — scrolling fatigue is creeping in
Overloaded — your brain is begging for a break
Live Instagram watch — session timer, scrolls, reels and today\'s fatigue.
